title: 单层商铺
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE new Yuan northern China map-building variant of the supplied Song sprite, circa 1271–1368 Dadu / Datong / Kaifeng. Reference is ONLY the realistic weathered matte timber, grey clay tile, plaster texture, muted earth palette and density of detail; replace regional subject, retain coherent game-sprite scale. Realistic ancient architectural asset, no toy plastic or ink painting. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30, EXACT 2:1 dimetric ground axes slopes +0.5 and -0.5; no perspective convergence, vertical pillars vertical. The visible SOUTH facade points lower-left. Flat thin rectangular contact footprint, clearly show left/front/right ground corners; back corner may be hidden. Footprint is 6 by 5 one-metre cells, visible front-facing ground edge runs down-right with length proportional to 6, other ground edge goes up-right proportional to 5. No thick diorama pedestal. A single storey northern street shop with simple grey tile gable roof, tan plaster side walls, dark timber open shopfront, wooden shutters and a few plain clay storage jars and sacks contained under the front eave. No lettering. Northern Yuan period concept, not a measured reconstruction. Avoid Ming-Qing ornate ridge figures, Qing imperial color schemes, horse-head firewalls, modern tourism facades and bright glazed tiles on common buildings. Light screen upper left, short soft contact shadow lower right only. Fully isolated on TRUE transparent RGBA alpha0 background. Keep whole roof and contact plane inside image with 10 percent transparent margin on ALL sides. No text, no watermark, no people, no sky, no environmental background, no checkerboard, no grid or annotations. One sprite only, never a sheet.
